tagline: Focus one target, or spread the bleed.
rows: Hound's Rush out-damaged the true mark dealers while his protective tools were too weak to bother with.
A protector who spreads bleed from range and leaves the big marked hits to others.
Both hound attacks work from any rank at ACC 85. Rush deals DMG -20%; Harry deals DMG -85%. Both bleed 2/2/3/3/4 for 3 turns.
Guard Dog gives +20–30% dodge, Cry Havoc heals 4–6 party stress more reliably, and Lick Wounds works from any rank.
